props.name: canAnchorItem
props.description: With `keepAnchorOnItemsChange`: which rows may be the row kept in place. A row this rejects is passed over like a removed one (the first accepted row after it keeps its place). For rows that new items are inserted below, such as a leading header row above a prepend: keeping such a row in place would push the rows below it, the ones being read. All rows may by default.

props.name: catchWheel
props.description: Scroll by the wheel in the list's own handler (where the pointer is not coarse), so rows are rendered in the same frame as the scroll; it lets the wheel through at either end.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders a row: called for each item in or near the view with the item, its index, the `domRef` to put on the row's root element and the `style` to spread on it. Give the element the `key` it gets.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns for a list that also scrolls sideways: only the columns in view are rendered, through `renderCol` or `renderItemWithCols`. Each column's `width` is read.

props.name: componentRef
props.type: ((instance: VirtualListApi | null) => void | (() => void | { [UNDEFINED_VOID_ONLY]: never; }) | DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES[keyof DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES]) | RefObject<VirtualListApi | null>
props.description: The imperative API: `scrollTo`, `getOffsetTopOfKey`, the scroller's and spacer's elements.

props.name: defaultScrollIndex
props.description: The index of the row to scroll to when the list mounts or `sessionId` changes.

props.name: defaultScrollKey
props.description: The key of the row to scroll to when the list mounts or `sessionId` changes (as far as needed to show it). `defaultScrollIndex` wins when both are set.

props.name: domRef
props.type: ((instance: HTMLDivElement | null) => void | (() => void | { [UNDEFINED_VOID_ONLY]: never; }) | DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES[keyof DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES]) | RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>
props.description: A ref to the scroller's element.

props.name: empty
props.description: Rendered in place of the rows when there are no items. A function gets a `domRef`: when its element resizes, `onContentResize` is called.

props.name: emptyAlign
props.description: Where `empty` sits: at the top (`"start"`) or in the middle of the list (`"center"`).

props.name: focusable
props.description: Put the scroller in the tab order (`tabIndex` 0), so the keyboard can scroll it; off, it is `tabIndex` -1.

props.name: footer
props.description: Rendered below the rows, inside the scroller. A function gets a `domRef`: when its element resizes, `onContentResize` is called.

props.name: footerAfterBottomPadding
props.description: Rendered last in the scroller, after `paddingBottom`.

props.name: getKey
props.description: A key for each item, stable across renders: measurements are kept by key, so they survive reordering and new items, and a new key is a new row, measured again from the estimate.

props.name: header
props.description: Rendered above the rows, inside the scroller. Keep its height the same while rows load above: a change in its height moves the rows in view.

props.name: ignoreItemResize
props.description: Stop applying row measurements: sizes measured while it is on are dropped, and the rows keep the sizes they had (for a moment when rows resize but the layout should not follow, such as an animation).

props.name: ItemComponent
props.description: A component that renders a row, in place of `children`; it gets the same props.

props.name: itemEstimatedSize
props.description: The size, in px, counted for a row not measured yet (its offset and the spacer's height).

props.name: itemMinSize
props.description: The shortest a row can be, in px, or less: to fill the view, rows not measured yet count at this size (after a jump, as many rows as fit at it, plus one), so a larger value leaves the end of the view empty. While the list scrolls, rows ahead of the view are mounted on top of these.

props.name: itemResizable
props.description: Rows have heights of their own: each row is measured from layout when it mounts and whenever it resizes (put the row's `domRef` on its root element). Off, every row is `itemEstimatedSize` high.

props.name: items
props.description: The items, one row each, in order.

props.name: itemsClassName
props.description: Classes of the spacer (`data-slot="virtual-list-items"`).

props.name: itemsStyle
props.description: Styles of the spacer (`data-slot="virtual-list-items"`), merged over its own.

props.name: keepAnchorOnItemsChange
props.description: When `items` change, keep the row at the top of the view where it is: the same row stays at the same distance from the view's top, so rows inserted or removed above it (most often a prepend, such as loading older history) do not move what is on screen. Also at the very top (`scrollTop` 0): the row that was first stays first in view and the new rows are above it, out of view. If that row was removed, the first row after it that is still there keeps its place; if none is left, `scrollTop` is kept. An instant jump still pending (`scrollTo` an index, a key, the top or the bottom, in the same frame) wins. Only with `virtual` on; a new `sessionId` resets the list as before.

props.name: keyboardPageBottomOcclusion
props.description: What covers the bottom of the list, in px (such as a composer over it): Page Up, Page Down and Space scroll by the view's height less this and 32px.

props.name: onContentResize
props.description: Called when the content's height changes: a row resizes or mounts measured, the spacer's height changes, or the `footer` / `empty` element resizes (to follow the end of a chat).

props.name: onRenderAnomaly
props.description: Called when the list renders too often: 120 forced renders within a second report a `"renderThrashing"` anomaly, for logging.

props.name: onResize
props.description: Called when the scroller itself resizes, with its ResizeObserver entry.

props.name: onScroll
props.description: Called when the list scrolls, with the native event, after the rows in view are updated.

props.name: onTransformChange
props.description: Called when the rows' offset (`--virtual-list-transform-y`) changes, for content positioned against it.

props.name: onWheel
props.description: With `catchWheel`: called with the native wheel event, except one let through at either end.

props.name: paddingBottom
props.description: Space below the footer, in px (before `footerAfterBottomPadding`).

props.name: paddingTop
props.description: Space above the first row, in px, inside the spacer.

props.name: printable
props.description: When printing, let the list grow to its content (no height limit, no scrolling).

props.name: renderCol
props.description: With `columns`: renders one column of a row; its result is the row's `renderedCols`.

props.name: renderItemWithCols
props.description: With `columns`: renders the columns in view of a row at once (in place of `renderCol`); its result is the row's `renderedItemWithCols`.

props.name: sessionId
props.description: Identifies what the list shows (a channel, a thread). A new value resets the list: scroll position, measurements and rows (every row remounts), then `defaultScrollKey` / `defaultScrollIndex` apply again.

props.name: showScrollbar
props.description: Show the scroller's native scrollbar (hidden by default).

props.name: virtual
props.description: Render only the rows in or near the view. Off, every row is rendered in flow (with `itemResizable`, the row at the top of the view keeps its place when it is switched off).

props.name: visibleItemsProps
props.description: Props of the element that holds the rows (`visibleItemsTag`), such as `role` or `aria-label`.

props.name: visibleItemsTag
props.description: The element that holds the rows (`data-slot="virtual-list-visible-items"`), such as `"ul"` for rows that are `li`.
